readiness_metric.name: Dataset Readiness Score
readiness_metric.description: A prototype data-engineering signal based on readable files, duplicates, labels, class balance, split integrity, and metadata completeness. It is not a clinical validation metric and must not be presented as one.

datasets.name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection
datasets.manual_setup: Place the authorized competition files under ml/datasets/raw/aptos2019/; keep train.csv beside the image directory.
limitations: The official competition metadata does not guarantee a patient identifier field; split generation will report this limitation when absent.

datasets.name: IDRiD
datasets.purpose: Retinal lesion analysis and clinical evidence.
datasets.manual_setup: Obtain IDRiD under its source terms and place the original images and ground-truth folders under ml/datasets/raw/idrid/.
limitations: IDRiD supports multiple lesion annotation formats; generic label validation does not replace lesion-specific schema validation.

datasets.name: DRIVE
datasets.manual_setup: Obtain DRIVE under its source terms and place training/test images and vessel masks under ml/datasets/raw/drive/.
limitations: Segmentation mask validation is represented as file-pair and readability checks; pixel-level mask semantics need a DRIVE-specific adapter.

datasets.name: Messidor / Messidor-2
datasets.manual_setup: Obtain Messidor or Messidor-2 under its source terms and place images plus authorized labels under ml/datasets/raw/messidor/.
limitations: External-validation labels and licensing vary by release; verify the supplied label mapping before analysis.
